c: On the classic form of an article in a knowledge base with a checklist, choose Perform AQI. On pdi2 only the KCS demo knowledge base has one.
say: On the classic form of an article in a knowledge base with a checklist, choose perform A Q I. On pdi2, only the KCS demo knowledge base has a checklist.

c: Tick each of the ten questions of Default AQI Survey the article meets. Each is worth 10 points.
say: Tick each of the ten questions the article meets. Each one is worth ten points.

c: Write your Comments for Author/Version Author and choose Submit AQI. After that, nobody can change it.
say: Write your comments for the author and choose submit. After that, nobody can change the review.

c: The score is the sum of the yes answers; 70 or more passes. It becomes the article's Latest AQI.
say: The score is the sum of the yes answers. Seventy or more passes. It becomes the article's latest A Q I.

c: The reviser, or the author, gets AQI Review for KB… with the score, Passed or Failed, and your comments.
say: The reviser, or else the author, is emailed the score, passed or failed, and your comments.
